definitions.explanation: Without any break or interruption. Describes an action or state that continues uninterrupted.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{降|ふ}っている。
{車|くるま}が{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる。
{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けたおかげで、ついに{夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}った。
examples.english: Thanks to my ceaseless efforts, my dream finally came true.

notes:
USAGE:
{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく is the adverbial form of {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない (unceasing). It modifies verbs and emphasizes the continuous, unbroken nature of an action. Somewhat literary.

FORMS:
{絶|た}える (to cease) + {間|ま} (interval) + なく (without) — literally "without a gap of ceasing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{続|つづ}く: to continue ceaselessly
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{降|ふ}る: to rain without pause
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{努力|どりょく}: ceaseless effort
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{流|なが}れ: an unbroken flow
